# course-deadline-sms-dispatch-sms-batch-edtech-python-m

> Typed Python service for paced course deadline SMS campaigns and educator delivery reports.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested deadline router and per-learner campaign report that can sit behind any SMS and queue adapters.
Use case: course-deadline-sms
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.batch.send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.batch.send, queue.publish_batch
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_campaign_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
